notes:
Photato is an unfinished alpha of a completely free native Swift image editor. Many planned functions are not yet available. Complete professional-workflow coverage and file compatibility are not claimed. The listing describes its AI-aided development and known limitations.

This record is draft preparation. We understand App Review Guideline 2.2 directs unfinished beta software to TestFlight. No review submission, public release or automatic TestFlight distribution is requested by this metadata update. Every release requires the maintainer's manual approval.

No sign-in, purchases, subscriptions, tips or paid unlocks are required. Ordinary editing runs locally. Optional Apple Intelligence uses system availability checks on eligible Apple Silicon/macOS26+ systems; supported image services may use Apple's Private Cloud Compute. The authenticated loopback API is optional and disabled until enabled by the user.

Draft media is captured from the actual 0.3.0 development build376 using original owned artwork. No build is selected in this App Store version. Reconcile media with the final selected and qualified build before submission. The earlier local App Store archive is332; it has not been uploaded or represented as376.

Source attribution is retained. The GitHub repository remains private until software release day.
